ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 9.0): Governor Fintiri Commends World Bank ARIN Partnership; Commissions Solar Mini-Grids in Hong LGA
KADUNA STATE (PSI 8.9): Kaduna Tops 2026 National Transparency and Integrity Index with 54.68% Score under Governor Sani
ABIA STATE (PSI 8.8): Governor Otti Charts Transition to Digital Commerce and Manufacturing at Igbo Day Lecture
BENUE STATE (PSI 8.7): Governor Alia Receives African Leadership Award at UNGA 81; Pursues Agro-Processing Investment
CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 8.6): Cross River Commences Strict Enforcement of WASH Regulations on Borehole Operators
DELTA STATE (PSI 8.5): Delta Upgrades Central Hospital Warri with MRI and CT Scan; Launches EV Workshop
GOMBE STATE (PSI 8.4): Gombe Commits N3.5bn Counterpart Funding for Nigeria for Women Project Scale-Up
EDO STATE (PSI 8.3): Edo Moves to Establish Blood Transfusion Service; Conducts Classroom Groundbreaking
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 8.2): Plateau House Confirms Service Commission; PRUWASSA Partners for 57,000 Displaced Persons
OSUN STATE (PSI 8.1): Governor Adeleke Celebrates Osun Ranking 5th Nationally in 2026 NECO Examinations
ANAMBRA STATE (PSI 8.0): Anambra Attorney General Directs Police Prosecution for Female Property Disinheritance
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 7.9): TRCN Flags Off Teacher Registration Compliance Monitoring in Zamfara; UNICEF Reviews VAC Plan
JIGAWA STATE (PSI 7.8): Jigawa Assembly Approves N1.337bn for State Radio Renovation and 5 New Community FM Stations
AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 7.7): Akwa Ibom Commissions 10.83km Mkpat Enin–Etinan Road with 30-Metre Bridge
LAGOS (PSI 9.2): Inspected 9MW generators for the 26MW embedded waterworks project, chaired Security Council meeting, and launched digital marketing training with Android phones for 600 artisans.
FCT ABUJA (PSI 9.1): Presided over EXCO approving immediate construction completion of Utako General Hospital, digital case management across 67 courtrooms, and N5.3bn Bwari satellite power lines.
ADAMAWA (PSI 9.0): Secured World Bank health nutrition commodity deliveries for October, inspected 216kWp and 265kWp solar mini-grids in Hong LGA, and pledged perimeter security for CoE Hong.
KADUNA (PSI 8.9): Emerged as Nigeria's top-ranked state in the 2026 Transparency and Integrity Index by CeFTPI with a 54.68% score across open procurement and fiscal transparency.
ABIA (PSI 8.8): Charted state commercial transition from physical retail trading to digital commerce and local manufacturing, highlighting youth global remote work under TechRise.
BENUE (PSI 8.7): Received the African Leadership Award for Grassroots Development at UNGA 81 in New York, pursuing international investor partnerships for soybean and fruit processing.
CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.6): Commenced strict enforcement of WASH water regulations, mandating registration, permits, geophysical testing, and quality certification for all commercial borehole drillers.
DELTA (PSI 8.5): Inspected operational 1.5 Tesla MRI, CT scan, and dialysis units at Central Hospital Warri, establishing a 30% revolving maintenance fund, and announced EV technical training.
GOMBE (PSI 8.4): Approved N3.5bn state counterpart funding for World Bank female micro-loan scale-up, while the Grazing Reserves Committee launched herder data documentation in Kwami and Dukku.
EDO (PSI 8.3): Initiated steps to establish a regulated State Blood Transfusion Service to eliminate laboratory quackery and performed groundbreaking for BASIA school classrooms.
PLATEAU (PSI 8.2): Confirmed House Service Commission leadership, passed State Police Bill to 2nd reading, and partnered with CRS/JDPC for 57,000 displaced persons under RAPID program.
OSUN (PSI 8.1): Celebrated Osun's rise to 5th position nationally in the 2026 NECO examinations with a 74.31% pass rate, climbing from 33rd position in 2022 following education investments.
ANAMBRA (PSI 8.0): Directing the Nigerian Police to investigate gender-based disinheritance complaints and transmit case files to the SGBV Unit for prosecution under the VAPP Law 2017.
ZAMFARA (PSI 7.9): Flagged off National Compliance Monitoring for teacher registration across three senatorial zones and reviewed the Violence Against Children Action Plan with UNICEF.
JIGAWA (PSI 7.8): Approved N1.337bn for the overhaul of the state main radio station and construction of five new community FM radio stations in Gumel, Gwaram, Hadejia, Kazaure, and Ringim.
AKWA IBOM (PSI 7.7): Commissioned the completed 10.83km Mkpat Enin–Etinan road featuring a 30-metre bridge, eliminating a criminal hotspot and reducing inter-LGA transit from 2 hours to 10 minutes.
